notes.title: One extra decimal house plus bank patch!
notes.content:
The experience text in battles will now display one extra decimal house.

Maybe it helps people figuring out where they are!

Money from bank will be generated automatically every 15 fights even when Battling.
There is no need to visit the bank anymore!
